decision.reasoning_trace: The search results contained several items that were not backpacks (drill bits, sleeping pads, towels), so I filtered the selection down to actual bags. Within the consideration set, the HIKPRO 20L (prod_backpacks_006) and the QT&QY Military Tactical Backpack (prod_backpacks_057) were the strongest contenders due to high ratings and positive reviews. I ultimately chose the QT&QY (prod_backpacks_057) because its 4.7-star rating across over 6,000 reviews indicates a high level of consumer satisfaction and durability for a multi-purpose bag. It offers excellent value and versatility compared to the more specialized skate or dry bags.
